# Encore Tweaks for MySU

Universal Android Performance, Battery & Thermal Tweaks ported natively for MySU.

### Features
- Native MySU JS Bridge integration powered by `@mysu-org/mysu`
- Pure `window.mysu` WebUI execution
- Embedded NDK r29 native `encored` daemon
- Dynamic per-app game profiling and inotify event monitoring

### Upstream Project
Maintained upstream by [Rem01Gaming](https://github.com/Rem01Gaming/encore). Ported natively to MySU by [kelexine](https://github.com/kelexine).

Universal Android Performance, Battery & Thermal Tweaks ported natively for MySU without legacy dependencies.

Features

releases.descriptionHTML:
Encore Tweaks v5.2.1 for MySU

First official release natively ported from source for MySU.

  • Replaced legacy KernelSU.js with native MySU.js
  • Built with @mysu-org/mysu@3.0.2
  • Integrated native NDK r29 compiled encored daemon
  • Supports dev.kelexine.mysu WebUI directly
